items.title: RBC bullish on Kraft Heinz, sees return to growth in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- RBC Capital Markets initiated coverage of Kraft Heinz at Outperform with a $32 price target in a note Thursday, arguing the packaged food maker is on the cusp of a return to growth that the market is underestimating.

items.title: 3 Value Stocks We Find Risky
items.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.
